question: Will the Global Protest Tracker report any protests in India or Pakistan with 10,000+ participants starting in November or December 2026?

calls.reasoning: Base rate: the Carnegie tracker logs roughly 4-7 new India entries per year plus several Pakistan ones; perhaps half or more are 10k+, implying ~45-60% for a new 10k+ entry starting in any 2-month window. Current environment is hot: the Cockroach movement in India, SKM's nationwide multi-day farmer actions from Nov 26 (it says 'lakhs' will join), and PTI resisting emergency rule in KP. Against: the tracker folds continuing movements into their original entry (the Cockroach movement appears tied to the June 2026 exam-scandal entry, and PTI's march began in Oct), SKM's anniversary protests in Nov 2024/2025 do not appear to have been listed, and update lag is large (last updated Sep 9 with entries only through Aug), so Nov/Dec events may not appear by resolution. No human market found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi.
calls.dossier:
- Carnegie Global Protest Tracker page (fetched 2026-10-28): 'Last updated September 9, 2026'; the latest entries anywhere are Aug 2026 (e.g., Germany, Ghana, Indonesia Aug 2026). There are no Sep/Oct 2026 entries yet. Lag from event to listing is about 1-2+ months.
- Tracker India entries (start month): Doctors Aug 2024; Labor codes Sep 2024; Manipur ethnic Sep 2024; Adani Nov 2024; Mosque survey Nov 2024; Bharat Bandh Jul 2025; Voter roll Aug 2025; Ladakh Sep 2025; US-India trade deal strike Feb 2026; Iran war Feb 2026; Women's quota Apr 2026; Exam scandals (+ 'satirical political movement', i.e. Cockroach) Jun 2026. Peak sizes were not visible in the fetched text.
- Pakistan entries (per search snippets): Kashmir (PoK seat reservation) Jun 2026; fuel tax protest Aug 2026; earlier PTI entries (e.g., Nov 2024 PTI march exists per Wikipedia).
- India Oct 2026: Cockroach Janta Party movement over voter-list revision. Leaders were detained at Jantar Mantar on Oct 13; >2,000 were detained around Oct 10 (Al Jazeera, Oct 10/13 2026). It started before November and appears linked to the June 2026 entry.
- SKM (farmers' union) called nationwide protests for Oct 23 and Nov 26, 2026, with multi-day mass actions at 100 locations including Delhi from Nov 26 and claimed participation of 'lakhs' (peoplesdemocracy.in, Oct 18 2026; counterview Aug 2026). The Nov 26 2024 and 2025 SKM anniversary actions do not appear as separate tracker entries in the fetched list.
- Pakistan Oct 2026: PTI launched a march Oct 4 after talks failed. Federal emergency rule was imposed in KP around Oct 11 for 6 months, ending PTI's provincial government. PTI calls it a coup and is bracing to fight it (Al Jazeera Oct 4/11/13 2026). These activities started in October.
- Status quo: no qualifying entry exists yet. Resolution needs a NEW tracker entry for India or Pakistan with a start date of Nov 1 - Dec 31, 2026 and a peak size >=10,000.
- Resolves off the Carnegie tracker listing (its start date and peak-size fields), not off news reports of crowd sizes.
- Event window: 2026-11-01 -> 2026-12-31 per the criteria; as of 2026-10-28, 0% elapsed.
- Searched but not found: the tracker's update cadence/schedule, peak-size values for India entries, any announced PTI Nov/Dec march dates, and any prediction market on this.
calls.reference_class: Two-month windows of new India+Pakistan Carnegie GPT entries with peak >=10k

calls.reasoning: Base rate: GPT logs roughly 2-2.5 India/Pakistan protests per year with peak 10,000+, implying ~30% for a 2-month start window. Major current mobilizations (India Cockroach/voter-roll movement, PTI KP emergency protests from Oct 11, JI petroleum-levy campaign since Aug) all started before Nov 1, and GPT typically folds escalations into existing entries, so a NEW entry is needed. GPT update lag (last update Sep 9, 2026) further cuts the chance a Nov-Dec protest appears by resolution. Offsetting: very elevated tension in both countries; JI promises mid-November Islamabad march that could be logged anew. No human market found (Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi checked via search; none).

- India: 'Cockroach Janta Party' youth movement (founded May 16, 2026) protesting voter-list revision removing ~130M voters; thousands detained in Delhi crackdown ~Oct 10, 2026 (NBC/NPR); Guardian Oct 19 calls it biggest challenge to Modi. Started before Nov -> likely an existing/pre-window entry.
- Pakistan: emergency rule imposed in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Oct 11, 2026; CM Sohail Afridi arrested; thousands of PTI supporters had been marching (Al Jazeera, Arab News). PTI 'braces to fight' takeover (Al Jazeera Oct 13).
- Pakistan: Jamaat-e-Islami petroleum-levy campaign: sit-ins announced Aug 16, strike Sep 3, Islamabad march launched Sep 20, halted Sep 22; on Oct 27 JI said march will resume mid-November (Dawn, Arab News). Could be logged as continuation (start Aug/Sep) or a new entry.
- Base-rate construction (rough, from entry counts): India ~3 GPT entries/yr, Pakistan ~1-2/yr; roughly half reach >=10,000 -> ~2-2.5 qualifying/yr combined; Poisson over 2 months ~0.35-0.4 expected events. Conditional caveat: GPT tends to fold escalations of ongoing movements into the existing entry.
- Status quo: no qualifying new-start entry unless a new trigger/movement arises and GPT logs it before resolution check.
- Markets: no Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi market found.

calls.reasoning: Base rate: the tracker adds about 3-5 India entries a year plus some Pakistan ones, mostly 10k+ peaks, so roughly 40% that a new qualifying entry starts in a given 2-month window. Unrest is high (anti-voter-list-revision movement and Nov 1 Delhi rally, farmers' union protests from Nov 26, Jamaat-e-Islami march resuming mid-November, PTI fighting emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa), which raises the odds. Against: the big movements began before November and will likely be folded into existing entries, and the tracker updates irregularly (latest update Sep 9 with August starts), so a Nov/Dec entry may not be published before the question is checked around Jan 1.
calls.reconciliation: Disputed facts: the tracker's lag and its latest entries. Fetched the tracker: last updated Sep 9, 2026, with entries starting as late as August 2026 (Bangladesh, Burkina Faso), so the lag can be about 1 month, not 2-3 (Run 3 was wrong). The fetch showed no Pakistan entries or peak sizes, probably truncation; could not check. The remaining disputes (whether ongoing movements get folded into existing entries, how likely a timely update is) are judgment calls. I put the base rate around 40%, then discounted for the publication-timing risk and the folding tendency, and gave back a little for high unrest. Landed at 0.30.
